reviews.text:
They remodeled our pool and we're loving it. Jennifer in the office was excellent on the financial side of things. Victor was very helpful, knowledgeable and attentive to our needs and concerns. He jumped through hoops like a pro! We have new plaster, tile and coping on the spa.
They added umbrella sleeves on the deck. Loving my tan! Scheduling was tuff, with many factors outside our control, originally planned for June start, they actually started in August and finished in 3 weeks.
reviews.author: Douglas deMarco

reviews.text: Five Star Pools turned out 20+ year old pool into one that looked brand new. Top notch workmanship from the crews and their work ethic was outstanding. Victor and Will were very helpful and kept us informed throughout the process. We are so happy with the outcome.
reviews.author: LeAnn Estep

reviews.text: I have hired several different pool companies, and the water always looked murky and was dirty. I gave the guys at five star a shot, and  last week I voiced some concerns and issues I was having they came out and found there was a tear in the filter already, and one of the valves was not closing all the way their attention to detail has our pool looking better than it ever has.
reviews.author: Bryan Graves

reviews.text: This company does a terrible job servicing pools and has caused damage to my property. I have contacted them multiple times to cancel and they ignore my contact and continue to charge my credit card for service they are not performing. DO NOT TRUST THESE PEOPLE WITH YOUR PROPERTY OR CREDIT CARD!
reviews.author: Michele Flores

reviews.text:
Update: 2025 summertime.  These liars didn't fix a problem,  just blocked off 2 pool jets and charged me for repairs of a "leak" that was never there. And Will, called me, said "oh we found a second leak" (of course I was oot and he couldn't send me photos or proof) and said we can just cap off the jet if you want. I said Absolutely NOT, (THAT MEANS NO). TOLD HIM I want ALL the pool jets to be working. Then in July, when I got my pool running ( by hiring another pool company) I realized they had blocked off 2 jets. I tried to reach out, but guess who changed his phone number?

Minus 20 score!! They are now are WJPool, or some version....please, don't use this liar cheating company. Any combination of will johnson and pools, run away. Thief's and liar's 10000%, especially Will.

I could rate them minus 5 star pools, that's what it would be. I've waited  months (yes months) for them to complete a job they had been paid to do, and they left a mess. Trash left behind, broken pieces of concrete,  rebar blue rubber gloves and a trash bucket.  That's minor compared to all the other complaints!! Guys name is Will J. Suppose to own this shady operation,  who really knows.  They lie, cheat, steal from you. Full of excuses, no work ethics. Don't show up or communicate why they didn't bother to be at a set/confirmed appointment. Why would I continue to work with them you may be asking,  because they did a leak detection and already got paid! Leak detection is expensive so I didn't want to hire some other company to re-do what had been done. My mistake. Typical Will, dont show up on confirmed appointment dates, then show up announced, pretend like he or his crew actually work, then leave, (oh and left the gate open and my 2 German Shepherd dogs got out) then deny that was them that left a gate open.... well, I wasn't home. 5-star pool staff, including Will, were on my property, my neighbor notified me my dogs were out. Hmmm, just another lie from Will. They didn't fix the problems they'd been paid to do. It took me 8 weeks to get them out here to finally finish this spring!! Daily calls to ask why they weren't here, text messages to Will directly,  He Never Replied!!! Because he'd been paid, why does he care.  My fault on paying him before I returned home from my work trip. Do NOT USE THIS COMPANY FOR ANY REASON!!! They've even changed their name because of the crap work & negative reviews. They are now operating under WPS (Wills Pool Supply) RUN, do not walk, they are not reliable.  Awful company and don't do good quality work. Will lied to me more than once.  He started this project in September 2024. That gives you perspective how Awful they are! Today 29APR25, the pool still isn't running right, water leaking after they supposedly repaired 4 leaks. Cheaters liars thieves. The BBB will be notified as well. I'm a senior citizen and I would say an easier target for this type of company to abuse. Even though I tried to hold them accountable,  it wasn't enough.   RUN. DON'T TRUST or hire them. I cannot say enough negativity about this company.  Disgusting company and owner.
reviews.author: Charla Tambourine

reviews.text: What a great experience we had with Will and his team.  Great service,  very prompt and extremely knowledgeable.  We appreciate all you guys do and will continue using this company for as long as I own a pool.
reviews.author: Chip & Trish Moore

reviews.text:
Will @ Five Star worked with us on resurfacing my 17-year old pool.  Great quality and service, craftsmanship; was detailed and met our expectations. Pool looks great again!  Communication on this job was great and crews kept to the construction schedule.  5 stars for sure.

After the resurfacing work, I needed a new computer.  The issue was identified and Will worked a lot of options before settling on a new computer being needed.  There were some other tech/personnel issues that caused the work to be delayed longer than needed.  Once getting the right attention, Will was able to come out and get me back up and running again.  Due to the personnel issues and that individual not communicating with me, I cannot give 5 stars right now but a solid 4-4.5 for sure.  I will use Will again for any maintenance issues I have in the future since I believe the personnel issues have been worked out for this company.  Overall, I recommend.
reviews.author: Jeff Phillips

reviews.text: From the owner to the office staff to the pool techs.  They are always on point and the best customer service.  Repair estimates and monthly service prices are fair and competitive.  Also very responsive in emergency situations which is most important to me.   Thank you Five Star Pools for providing five star service each and every time.
reviews.author: Trish

data.summary: The reviews present a polarized and concerning picture. Positive reviews are detailed and authentic-feeling, citing specific staff and project outcomes. However, the negative reviews are severe, alleging ongoing fraudulent charges, ignored cancellation requests, property damage, and intentionally poor repairs. The low total review count (21) and lack of presence on other platforms makes pattern analysis difficult but increases the weight of each individual complaint. The BBB profile, while lacking detail, does not show accreditation or a rating, which is a neutral to slightly negative signal. The content of the negative reviews is highly specific and damning.
fake_signals: Low review volume (21) for an established contractor
Lack of reviews on other major platforms (Yelp, Houzz, Angi)
Potential for review manipulation is unclear due to low volume
authentic_signals: Specific details in positive reviews (names: Jennifer, Victor, Will; project types: remodel, plaster, tile)
Emotional authenticity in negative reviews (specific accusations of fraud, damage, ignored cancellation requests)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one primary rating source (Google) is available. BBB data is incomplete and shows no rating or complaints.
